title: Broan-NuTone — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Broan-NuTone.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Ventilation Authority." Premium tier. Broan-NuTone is the largest residential ventilation manufacturer in North America. They make range hoods, bath fans, and IAQ products for every price point from builder-grade to premium. Part of Madison Industries, Broan-NuTone also owns the Best and Venmar brands. If a house has a range hood or bath fan, there is a good chance it is Broan.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Every ventilation need — builders, renovations, replacements. The default recommendation when budget matters.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Broan-NuTone:

• Largest ventilation manufacturer in North America — the standard

• Every price point from $50 builder-grade to $1,500 premium

• Parts and replacements available everywhere — 60+ years of market presence

• Best by Broan for premium applications, Venmar for HRV/ERV

• Most service technicians know Broan products — easiest to maintain
